

```python
import argparse
import math
import random
import sys
import threading
import time

import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.sensor as sens

# Initialize PyChrono environment
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))

# Create ground body for visualization
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(10, 10, 0.1, 1000, True, True)
ground.SetName("Ground body")
ground.SetFixed(True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.05))
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
system.Add(ground)

# Create a mesh object for visualization
mesh = chrono.ChVisualShapeBox(10, 10, 0.1)
mesh.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.8))
mesh.SetOpacity(0.3)
ground.AddVisualShape(mesh)

# Create a moving body to simulate a vehicle or object
moving_body = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(2, 1, 0.5, 1000, True, True)
moving_body.SetName("Moving body")
moving_body.SetFixed(False)
moving_body.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.25))
moving_body.SetRot(chrono.QuatFromAngleZ(chrono.CH_PI_2))
system.Add(moving_body)

# Create a sensor manager and register sensors
sensor_manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)
sensor_manager.SetAmbientLightIntensity(0.8)
sensor_manager.SetUseRaytracing(False)

# Create camera sensor
camera = sens.ChCameraSensor(moving_body, 0.0, 1.0, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))
camera.SetName("Camera sensor")
camera.SetUpdateRate(10)
camera.SetImageWidth(640)
camera.SetImageHeight(480)
camera.SetFOV(chrono.CH_PI / 4)
camera.SetUseRaytracing(True)
camera.SetUseDepth(True)
camera.SetUseNormal(True)
sensor_manager.AddSensor(camera)

# Create lidar sensor
lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(moving_body, 0.0, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000,
